description: Uninstall one Workbench component by id from a target — the inverse of install_component — for a bounded, documented subset with an automated uninstall (e.g. `opencode`, `pnpm`, `npm-mcps`, `skills`, `docker-containers`); `component` must be an id from describe_workbench. Idempotent: an already-absent component reports `absent`; a component with no automated uninstall (system packages such as git/curl/node) reports `manual`. Destructive and consent-gated: without `confirm:true` it returns a preview and changes nothing, and it deletes only that component's files — never `opencode.json` or the profile repo. Parameter semantics: `workspace` sets the profile path some removals need; `dryRun` reports without changing. Use it to tear down one component; for several, call it per id.

confirm.description: Set true to actually remove. When absent, the call returns a preview and makes no changes.

dryRun.description: Report the action without changing anything.

target.description: The machine to operate on: this host (local) or a remote host over SSH (ssh).

mode.description: Run on this machine (local) or a remote host (ssh).

user.description: SSH user (defaults to ssh config / current user).

workspace.description: Profile repo directory (used by components whose removal needs it).

name: remove_component

action.description: What happened: removed, updated, already absent, or manual (no automated uninstall).

requiresConfirmation.description: True when the call returned a preview without acting; re-call with confirm:true.

title: Remove one Workbench component
